status: post-freeze sensitivity analysis, training 5-fold CV and training-row sweeps only; nothing scored on the held-out partition, no slug frozen, no existing results file modified
folds: common.CV = StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=2607526); checked against data/processed/cv_folds.csv
nadeau_bengio: mine_v2_utils.corrected_t_ci(diffs, 4, 1): variance x (1/5 + 1/4), t with 4 df, 95%
sd_note: sd_auc is np.std over the 5 fold AUCs (ddof=0, as in the frozen cv_auc_std)

sweep_definition.profiles: training median profile (categoricals at the rounded median level) and the 200 random training rows drawn by np.random.default_rng(2607526).choice(20975, 200, replace=False), as in model_monotone.py
sweep_definition.grid: the codes of PAY_k observed in train.csv
sweep_definition.as_frozen: only PAY_k (and its own DEL / flag columns for recoded models) changes; MAX_DELAY and N_MONTHS_DELAYED keep their old values, as in model_monotone.py
sweep_definition.consistent: MAX_DELAY = max(PAY_1..PAY_6) clipped at 0 and N_MONTHS_DELAYED = #(PAY_k > 0) are recomputed, as in common.clean()
sweep_definition.step_classes: non_delinquent: both codes <= 0; entry_into_arrears: from <= 0 to >= 1; between_delay_levels: k -> k+1 with k >= 1 (only these are counted as wrong-direction steps in the headline)
sweep_definition.violation: the predicted probability falls on the step (strictly, tolerance 0, as in model_monotone.py)
sweep_definition.thin_cell: either code has fewer than 100 training rows in that month

cross_state_check.definition: consistent mode (MAX_DELAY, N_MONTHS_DELAYED recomputed); for each month, every pair (s, k) with s in {-2, -1} and k >= 1 a code observed in train.csv; violating = profiles with p(PAY_k = k) < p(PAY_k = s). Not covered by the adjacent grid steps; the respecified constraint does not guarantee it (flags free).
